title: BinaId
description: Which build of a game is installed.

manassa.description: The launcher's own build identifier, where the launcher has one. Steam reports a numeric `buildid`; GOG reports a build hash; several launchers report nothing at all, which is exactly why the fingerprint exists.

basma.description: The fingerprint of the text-bearing files.

adad_malaffat.description: How many files went into the fingerprint, so that a fingerprint computed over a partially downloaded installation is recognisable as one.

waqt.description: When the fingerprint was computed, RFC 3339.
